cursor.observed: 2026-10-05, isolated desktop profile, pre-tag candidate (not published 0.1.1 release-channel acceptance). In separate runs the Cursor IDE imported https://github.com/straddle-build/skills as a team marketplace. Every import resolved the default branch at source f2d9656194612b4c15fdcbf881d884b93d5245c9, including an import of a /tree/v0.1.0 URL; the IDE import and marketplace edit offer no ref control. Install listed straddle 0.1.1 with 9 skills and straddle-api/straddle-docs, and a fresh reinstall after removal also succeeded. The Straddle API key variable field appeared under Configure after install, not at Add; no value was entered or saved. With the existing Local 0.1.0 plugin temporarily removed, the 0.1.1 plugin registered plugin-straddle-straddle-api and plugin-straddle-straddle-docs, and after reload both ran MCP initialization and tool discovery (straddle-api 4 tools) with no key and no tool call. Each run ended with uninstall and marketplace removal, and Local 0.1.0 and the plugin and MCP configuration files were restored with identical per-file sha256. Not restored: Cursor's own built-in skills sync and small ~/.cursor file rewrites, and the Straddle MCP transports were left connected where they had been idle-suspended. The Cursor web dashboard was inspected after a team-admin sign-in: Import from Repo takes only a repository URL and rejected https://github.com/straddle-build/skills/tree/v0.1.0 as an invalid URL format; the owner/repo import succeeded with no ref control, and its settings offer Refresh and Auto Refresh but no ref, tag or branch control; that marketplace was then deleted, returning the dashboard to no connected marketplace. Update was exercised with a fixture repository, hello-keith/me810-cursor-fixture-20261005 (public, Actions disabled): its default branch was pushed at 6e7320dc81c7a7c20464a7aec7fe1e5496b0e9e0 (plugin 0.1.0), imported as a team marketplace and the plugin added, and Cursor installed straddle from that commit (plugin.json 0.1.0, 9 skills, both MCP servers; the detail view showed no version label) with the Straddle API key field under Configure, left empty. The default branch was then fast-forwarded to f2d9656194612b4c15fdcbf881d884b93d5245c9 (0.1.1). About a minute later, after the marketplace view was opened and before Refresh was pressed, Cursor installed straddle from f2d9656 (plugin.json 0.1.1, 9 skills) and removed the 0.1.0 copy, with Auto Refresh on and no re-add or reconfiguration. The plugin was then uninstalled and the marketplace removed, and Local 0.1.0 was restored with identical per-file sha256. Deleting the fixture repository is pending with its owner. No business API request
